==Overview==
'''Section A''' is the first section the player will encounter, where the player will open the door labeled '''A-001''' to begin. The first few doors are straight forward, open a door, pass through a room, and then open the next. Piano music can be heard in the background and no lockers spawn as well. However, once the player passes a few room, the first entity appears, [[A-20]]. After a few more entity encounters and reaching door A-400, the next section can be found, [[Section D]].

This is the only section that originates from the [https://www.roblox.com/games/5076734934/Rooms original game], along with two entities, [[A-60]] and [[A-200]].

== Short Strategies ==
*Some rooms contain safe spots, a spot where no locker is needed to not be killed, use these spots in hard locker situations.
*Since there's no entities who can threat you while you're in blue or green locker or red fridge, they become safest spots to hide.
*In [[Red Rooms]], main threat is [[A-135]], due to its very early arrival and speed increment. To counter it, you can use help of [[A-60]], since it can break doors without spawning ''A-135''. Use this strategy is there's no blue lockers nearby.

== Full Guide ==
=== A-000 - A-021: ===
#Firstly, there is no threat except [[Void|The Void]] and [[Claustrophobia]] - the only two entities that appears at the start of the game and does not despawn. The tip for them: do not hide for too long, and do not fall behind or either you'll die.
#Secondly, just know: A-000 to A-100 is a rooms where you can easily find tools that helps you in the progress. So here is the another tip: look on the floor and wait for the prompt - best tactic to find items, helps even in the deep darkness.
#And thirdly, do not be scared. Yes the game may seem scary, but that's just because you are playing this game for first time. Even if you die, you can find out the entities. Ahh yes, you can ask the professionals to help. But isn't that much better to complete the game with yourself? So i will repeat: do not be scared.

=== A-021 - A-060: ===
#Firstly, now you have two more threats: [[A-20]] and [[A-20i]]. Just remember: if you hear a whisper-like sound, get to any hiding spot that is not a table, then wait the screen static to get stronger, then hide and wait until the entity has passed away. Now you are safe.
#Secondly, as already was said, A-000 - A-100 is a best rooms for looting. So just loot it.
#Thirdly, A-20i instantly kills while A-20 does not. Just know it for your safety.

=== A-060 - A-085: ===
Another 2 threats appears: [[A-60]] and [[A-60i]]. They are the same as [[A-20]] and [[A-20i]], but they both can linger in the latest opened room, and break doors. Also [[A-60]] is way more quiet, [[A-60i]] is absolutely silent while rushing but can't spawn without [[A-60]]. To avoid dying from them, just add the volume and if you hear static-like noise, stay near any hiding spot that is not a table like with [[A-20]] and [[A-20i]]. Then wait for the screen static and hide. Despite [[A-20]]\[[A-20i]] tactic, wait for the sound to disappear, then unhide. But if your screen static does not disappeared, HIDE QUICKLY. It's the [[A-60i]] that is silent while far away. That's all.

=== A-085 - A-100 ===
A new horror known as [[A-85]] appears. It acts like that of [[A-20]], but it comes from the front. To survive, make sure you hid in a locker, as it gives you 4 seconds to react.

=== A-100 - A-120 ===
#The game really begins. You now have access to the A-100 checkpoint. The rooms now have a chance to have a light not functional, or no lights functional at all. This prompts you to use the Flashlight in your starter inventory (Or the Faraday Shakelight if you have the gamepass). It gives off a light that allows you to see in the dark. It does require batteries to recharge though (Faraday Shakelight discharges alarmingly faster and requires shaking to recharge it instead of batteries), so make sure you looted from A-000 - A-100 (Checkpoints that aren't the start of sections give you a random amount of batteries anyway).
#An exceptionally rare variant of [[A-85]], [[A-85i]], starts appearing. [[A-85i]] acts like [[A-85]] at first, but after a span of 1 minute or more, it rebounds. You must've opened enough doors in between [[A-85i]]s rebounds, If you open enough doors, [[A-85i]] will count it as a ''Successful Rebound''. After 3 ''Successful Rebounds'', it '''ENRAGES''', causing it to be faster. After 6-8 ''Successful Rebounds'', it despawns.

=== A-120 - A-135 ===
[[A-120]] starts appearing. It comes behind the door of the current room, then falls back. It occasionally glitches out and stops in place before regaining its speed. Once it has traveled far back enough, it has a chance to either rebound and come back again to repeat the cycle, or despawn with a static sound.

=== A-135 - A-200 ===
#[[A-135]] starts appearing. It clutters and mimics [[A-120]]. To identify if it's really [[A-135]], pay attention to its sound. If you hear drums and chittering, then it's [[A-120]]. If you hear slow drums and no chittering, then it's [[A-135]]. After stalling for a bit at the front, it breaks the door and starts checking gray lockers in the 3 most recent rooms where it spawned. After doing the thing, it falls back and despawns.
#[[A-135]] can be rarely replaced by [[A-135i]]. [[A-135i]] comes from the back and makes a laughing sound then a bang. This is an indication you should hide in a blue locker (or a table if you're a masochist). [[A-135i]] comes to check gray lockers in all the rooms that contain players in them. After it does that, it falls back. Has a chance to come back again and repeat the cycle, or outright despawn.

=== A-200 - A-300 ===
#[[A-200]] is now present. It spawns from the front and does knocking sounds on the door before it breaks the door completely. Once it breaks the door, it goes backwards and will dissapear with a howl if traveled far enough. It rebounds, touches the door then goes backwards again when a player isn't hidden or a 1 in 25 chance of doing so anyway. It can only touch the door up to 4 times before it dissapears, as to prevent it from lasting forever.
#[[A-200i]] may spawn after [[A-200]] despawns. It goes up through a blue portal then rushes back a random amout of rooms before it dissapears or rebounds to touch the door to either do it again or dissapear. Once it dissapears, it goes down the same portal from when it first spawned.

=== A-300 - A-500 ===
[[Mouth]] can now rarely appear. It waits at the back of a door until either a player tries to open it, or 1 second has passed. It then breaks the door and starts to give chase. It chases you down near the Voidwall, before going back and despawning. You cannot go around [[Mouth]], as it kills you if you try to.

=== A-500 - A-750 ===
All rooms go completely dark.

=== A-750 - A-900 ===
An extra ambience plays and the game tells you you're approaching [[Red Rooms|something darker]].

=== A-900 - A-1000 ===
#You have just reached [[Red Rooms]]. The lights are red in this section and the [[Entities|entities]] are more dangerous than before. 
#[[A-20]] always gets replaced by [[A-20i]] there. Good luck.

=== A-1000 ===
A long hallway appears and [[Red Rooms]] has ended. You will have successfully dodged every threat and have reached the "end" of '''Sector A'''.

=== A-1001 ===
You can now choose between exiting the '''Apartment''', giving you an ending, or you can enter ''Endless Mode''.

=== A-1002 - A-1200 ===
Once you enter ''Endless Mode'', You go through A-1001+ and dwell deeper into the unknown. Past this point, you get a checkpoint every 500 rooms. A-1500, A-2000, A-2500, and so on.

=== A-1200 - A-5000 ===
#[[X-1200 Entities]] start to appear. More information about them is in their page. 
#Once you reach this point and every other 400 rooms past that point, all entity spawns increase by 100%. Entity spawns were 100% before, but once you reach A-1200, it's 200%, A-1600 gives 300% and so on.

=== A-5000+ ===
#All rooms go completely dark once again.
#No Escape. We Are Infinity.

== Trivia ==
* '''Section A''' is the only section that appears in almost every rooms fangame. It has several means (Apartment, Agency, Archives, etc), but it always will be rooms made from light gray wood and always has gray and blue lockers. And despite you can't hide under the tables in the original Rooms game, most rooms fangames' creators adds this ability.

== Lore ==
* '''Section A''' and [[Section D]] were both abandoned because SPAWN needed to take a lot of power that was being fed into both Sections and focus it on more important things.
** this was ment to be a temporary thing, but the entities had overrun both Section due to lack of direct control.
